abilities.name: Brood Instinct
abilities.text: Use before a Friendly Unit makes an Evade Roll. Apply a +1 Modifier to that roll.

abilities.name: Zerg Creep
abilities.text: During Army Building, select exactly one Creep Card and add it to the Army List, paying its listed cost (if any).

abilities.name: Rapid Burrowing
abilities.text: Select one Friendly, Unengaged Ground Zerg Unit on the battlefield. That Unit gains the Burrowed Status, even if it has already been Activated this Round.
